## New Bristol campaign evidence

### Ma-ad Science Mayhem — Bristol Dockyards

- Runs **26 September–1 November 2026**.
- Shaun the Sheep-themed science challenges take place across the site, indoors and outdoors.
- Included with General Admission or the Afternoon Saver.
- Online General Admission: child £14.50; adult £22.
- On-the-door General Admission: child £16.50; adult £25.
- Afternoon Saver from 14:30: £13 online; £15 on the door.
- Full-price general-admission tickets give the named ticket holder free return visits for a year.
- Under-14s must be accompanied by an adult.
- The organiser does not publish a numerical recommended age for the challenge.
- Visitor parking is £5.60 for up to five hours; Bristol's Clean Air Zone may apply.
- Sources:
  - https://www.bristoldockyards.org/whats-on/ma-ad-science-mayhem
  - https://www.bristoldockyards.org/tickets
- Checked: **21 September 2026, 09:02 BST**

### Windmill Hill City Farm — candidate for the weekend mix

- Open seven days, 09:00–17:00.
- Free entry; donations welcomed.
- Farm animals, gardens, children's play area, picnic spots and a woodland walk.
- Public areas are described as accessible, although paths can be muddy in wet weather.
- Source: https://windmillhillcityfarm.org.uk/pages/visit
- Checked: **21 September 2026, 08:58 BST**

This is a supporting candidate, not a completed roundup. Further organiser checks are still needed before the Friday 25 September edition; expired catalog items were not reused.
